sloka: सा तस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा भर्तृ व्यसन पीडिता ।अब्रवीत् उत्तरम् तारा हनूमन्तम् अवस्थितम् ॥४-२१-१२॥
transliteration: sā tasya vacanam śrutvā bhartṛ vyasana pīḍitā ।abravīt uttaram tārā hanūmantam avasthitam ॥4-21-12॥

translations.english: On hearing Hanuman's words, Tara, tormented by the death of her husband said to Hanuman who was waiting for her reply:
